authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled registration-owners report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize only the repository-local read-only owners source, worker resolution and disposable two-account verification under the existing schedule/audit semantics. The source may expose only documentId, fullName, primaryContact, city, financialResponsible, status and createdAt, derive tenant scope from the claimed schedule, apply strict inclusive UTC createdAt dates, deterministic fullName/id order and a 10,000-row bound, and fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed source output. Exclude patient joins, patient/microchip data, owner master/CRUD, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing owners schema/RLS, metadata semantics, owner lifecycle, adding patient joins/filters/fields, adding another registry report, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.
